label: Produced because of its goodness: favouring depends on betterness with D-realization fixed
term: because of its goodness (controlled goodness reading)
definition: BecauseOfGoodness good fitOf φ s x y is DependsUnder good fitOf φ s x y: at s the betterness standard ranks x over y and the source favours x over y, and in some scenario with the same realization of D (fitOf) where the betterness standard does not rank x over y, the source does not favour x over y. A source determined to D fails; a good-general source tracking betterness passes, whatever the bearer; a perverse or biased profile favouring what is not better fails.
note: Analyst reading BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_2. It needs, for the contrast in question, a scenario in which betterness differs while D-realization is the same. Such variation can come from other content (c over d, cBetter against actual) and then need not be counterpossible; a scenario that varies betterness with the candidates' whole content fixed is counterpossible if goodness is fixed by content. Only if betterness factors through D-realization does no profile meet this reading (GoodDependenceLaws law 4). See docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md §§65–69.
